description: This file defines the 'Theme' class in the Opencart admin controller event namespace, handling theme-related actions such as adding, editing, and deleting themes by scheduling corresponding tasks.

classes.name: Theme
classes.description: Controller class handling theme-related events such as addition, editing, and deletion of themes in the admin panel.

methods.name: addTheme
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate new theme data after a theme is added.

methods.name: editTheme
methods.description: Schedules a task to update theme data after a theme is edited.

methods.name: deleteTheme
methods.description: Schedules a task to handle theme deletion.
